title: You Don't Need to Run Every Eval
abstract: arXiv:2606.24020v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A modern model release reports scores on 40+ benchmarks and the same evaluations were run many more times before it: to track training progress, compare design choices, and select the checkpoint for the release. But do we need to run every eval? We compile a public score matrix of 84 frontier models on 133 benchmarks (2,604 cells, 23.3% filled) and find it is approximately rank-2: a model's scores across all benchmarks are largely determined by just two numbers. We confirm this in two ways: (i) scores hidden from the matrix are best recovered using two factors, and (ii) two factors already explain over 90% of the variation among models on the benchmarks they share. Building on this, we design BenchPress: a logit-space rank-2 matrix completion method that recovers held-out scores to within 4.6 points. Using BenchPress, we find a subset of five benchmarks {GPQA-D, HLE, Codeforces, MMLU-Pro, ARC-AGI-1} that can recover the rest of a mod

translated_title: 你不需要运行每个评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.24020v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：一个现代模型发布报告在40多个基准测试上的分数，而同样的评估在发布之前已经运行了更多次：以跟踪训练进度、比较设计选择，并选择用于发布的检查点。但我们真的需要运行每个评估吗？我们编制了一个包含84个前沿模型在133个基准测试上的公开分数矩阵（2604个单元格，填充率为23.3%），并发现它近似为秩-2：一个模型在所有基准上的分数主要由两个数字决定。我们通过两种方式证实了这一点：（i）从矩阵中隐藏的分数最好用两个因子恢复，（ii）两个因子已经解释了共享基准上模型之间90%以上的变异。基于此，我们设计了BenchPress：一种对数空间秩-2矩阵补全方法，可将隐藏分数的恢复误差控制在4.6分以内。使用BenchPress，我们找到了一个包含五个基准的子集{GPQA-D, HLE, Codeforces, MMLU-Pro, ARC-AGI-1}，它可以恢复模型其余部分的分数。
tldr: 该论文发现前沿模型的基准分数矩阵近似为秩-2，并设计了BenchPress方法，用仅五个基准即可准确预测模型在其他所有基准上的表现，从而无需运行每个评估。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that the benchmark score matrix of frontier models is approximately rank-2 and designs BenchPress, which uses only five benchmarks to accurately predict a model's performance on all others, eliminating the need to run every eval.
